children: Horizon Gold's latest exploration results give MA Moelis Australia confidence in "the abundance of gold" at its Gum Creek project, MA analysts say. There appears to be opportunity for further resource expansion, particularly at the Kingfisher prospect, says MA. "While we suspect established producers will be the first beneficiaries of renewed investor interest in gold equities (given the immediate earnings and free cash flow), we see considerable scope for developers such as HRN to outperform as risk appetite returns and investors seek greater relative value," MA says. It has a buy rating and target price of A$3.15 on Horizon. Shares are down 1.0% at A$0.98, trimming the stock's week-to-date gain to 8.9%. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
